svg.title: What the agents pay
svg.desc: For each configuration beside 24 agent sessions, the median of its runs and their range for the agents' TTFT p99, for the share of the engine's steps over the calls in which the budget cap kept agent prefill out, and for make-room's own preemptions over the calls: tuned vLLM (the baseline, 10 runs): TTFT p99 106 s (96 to 129), no budget cap, no KV preemption; preempt-resubmit (before the first byte, 5 runs): TTFT p99 193 s (160 to 232), 181% of tuned vLLM's, no budget cap, no KV preemption; the KV preemption (#63350, 5 runs): TTFT p99 112 s (98 to 131), 105% of tuned vLLM's, agent prefill held in 0% of the steps (0% to 0%), 34 preemptions by make-room (24 to 46); the change (16-token window, 5 runs): TTFT p99 105 s (99 to 130), 99% of tuned vLLM's, agent prefill held in 25% of the steps (20% to 27%), 32 preemptions by make-room (22 to 35); and the configuration to deploy (48-token window, 15 runs): TTFT p99 111 s (94 to 132), 105% of tuned vLLM's, agent prefill held in 33% of the steps (26% to 38%), 31 preemptions by make-room (23 to 38).
